upsert.title: NFL Big Data Bowl 2027
upsert.summary: Kaggle data-science competition on NFL tracking data, with separate Open and University tracks and a Grand Prize presented at the 2027 NFL Scouting Combine.
upsert.eligibility: Anyone with a Kaggle account aged 18+ (or age of majority where they live); India not excluded. Residents of Crimea, DNR/LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and sanctioned persons are excluded.

prize.description: US$100,000 cash: Open Track $45,000, University Track $45,000 (3 finalists $10,000 each, 3 runners-up $5,000 each per track) and a $10,000 Grand Prize.

upsert.title: Name That LLM: Identify the Model Behind the Text (Google x Kaggle)
upsert.summary: Kaggle machine-learning competition sponsored by Google: build a model that identifies which LLM produced a given text.
upsert.eligibility: Anyone with a Kaggle account aged 18+; India not excluded. Residents of Crimea, DNR/LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and sanctioned persons are excluded.

prize.description: US$50,000 cash: top 10 places win $5,000 each.

notes: Details taken from an aggregator summary; confirm on the Kaggle competition page.
